# PatentPC

> > PatentPC is a global intellectual property firm providing patents, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyright protection services with AI-powered tools and flexible payment options.

PatentPC operates offices in Silicon Valley, Vietnam, and Kenya, serving startups and enterprises with comprehensive IP protection strategies. The firm combines legal expertise with AI-driven assessment tools to help innovators protect their intellectual property across multiple domains.

## Key Topics

- Patent protection and prosecution
- Trademark registration and brand protection
- Intellectual property strategy
- AI and machine learning patents
- Software and business method patents
- Blockchain and fintech patents
- Autonomous vehicle patents
- Digital healthcare patents
- Utility patents and design patents
- Provisional applications
- Patent licensing and investor requirements
- IP valuation and startup guidance
- USPTO compliance
- Innovation protection
- IP management

## Industry Patent Analysis

- [Artificial Intelligence Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/artificial-intelligence-ai): AI patent guide covering generative AI, machine learning, and OpenAI/Midjourney patent examples.
- [Autonomous Vehicle Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/autonomous-vehicles): Autonomous vehicle patent analysis featuring Google, Tesla, Uber, and Ford patent examples.
- [Software Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/software): Software patent guide covering business methods, e-commerce, databases, and Alice decision implications.
- [Blockchain and Fintech Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/blockchain-and-fintech): Blockchain and fintech patent analysis covering cryptocurrency and computer-implemented inventions.
- [Digital Healthcare Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/digital-healthcare): Digital healthcare patent analysis covering telemedicine, IoT, and blockchain healthcare applications.
- [Communications Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/communications): Communications patent analysis covering 5G, 6G, wireless technology, and telecom innovation.
- [Electronics Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/electronics): Electronics patent analysis covering semiconductor technology, transistors, and CMOS innovation.
- [3D Printing Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/3-d-printing): 3D printing patent guide covering additive manufacturing, stereolithography, and digital light processing.
- [Metaverse Patents](https://patentpc.com/industries/metaverse): Metaverse patent analysis covering virtual reality, augmented reality, and Web3 technology.
- [Cannabis Patents and Trademarks](https://patentpc.com/industries/cannabis-patents-and-trademarks): Cannabis industry IP guide covering patents, trademarks, and FDA compliance under 2018 Farm Bill.
